Social Media & Content Creator Job at Green Baskit




        
    

        
        Green Baskit, operated by Mimundo Limited, is a Lagos-based food production company built around a simple belief: Eating well shouldn't mean giving up the snacks Nigerians grew up loving. We take familiar local favourites kilishi, dankwa, roasted nuts, seeds and more and prepare them the clean way: naturally sourced, free of artificial additives, and made to actually taste good.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Social Media & Content Creator

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Plan, create and publish engaging content across Green Baskit's social media platforms.
	Shoot and edit videos/Reels and physically create product content in-house.
	Build and maintain a content calendar, and follow through on planned content.
	Identify content opportunities, trends and creative ideas relevant to the brand.
	Work with the marketing team to translate campaigns, products and promotions into engaging content.
	Track content performance and adjust approach based on engagement insights.


Requirements


	A degree in a relevant field.
	At least 3 years of experience in content creation/social media.
	A strong content portfolio is required.


Skills & Competencies:


	Video/Reels creation capability and comfort appearing on camera.
	Strong visual sense, creativity and attention to detail.
	Proactive, self-driven, and able to work independently to meet deadlines.
	Ability to translate campaigns and promotions into engaging, on-brand content.
	Experience creating content for an e-commerce, food, FMCG or lifestyle brand is an advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of your mail.

 Job Position: Sales Associate

	Strong communication and negotiation skills.
	Customer relationship management and business/market development ability.
	Target-oriented, resilient and persistent under pressure.
	High integrity, accountability and a genuine team-player mindset.
	Effective problem-solving in fast-moving field conditions.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Aviation Compliance Analyst",
  "description": "Zipline - Do you want to change the world? Zipline uses drones to deliver critical and life-saving medicine to thousands of hospitals serving millions of people in multiple countries. Our mission is to provide every human on Earth with instant access to vital medical supplies. Join Zipline and help us make this a reality for billions of people.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position:&nbsp;Aviation Compliance Analyst - Africa

Job Location: Abuja (Remote)

About You and The Role


	Zipline is looking for an Aviation Compliance Analyst to support aviation regulatory compliance across our Africa operations. This role will help ensure that Zipline&rsquo;s flight operations, site operations, regulatory submissions, reporting practices, and internal compliance processes remain aligned with applicable aviation requirements and Zipline&rsquo;s safety and operational standards.
	You will work closely with the Global Aviation team, Africa regulatory and operations teams, and country leadership. The role may be remote, but it will require regular travel to Zipline nests and operational sites across Africa to support implementation, audits, regulatory engagement, documentation, and cross-functional training.
	This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable moving between detailed compliance work and practical operational execution. The right candidate will be able to understand regulatory requirements, translate them into clear operating practices, build trust with internal and external stakeholders, and help teams maintain compliance in a fast-moving aviation environment. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-growing, multi-country aviation environment where structure, audit readiness and regulatory discipline are essential to operational scale.
	This role is remote and includes substantial travel across the African countries in which Zipline operates.


What You&#39;ll Do&nbsp;


	Assist cross-functional teams in preparing regulatory approval packages, documenting conditions of approval, and maintaining post-approval compliance records.
	Maintain and update aviation manuals, regulatory documents, and operating materials to align with approved operations and applicable regulations.
	Format, organize, and version-control materials required for regulatory approvals, audits, inspections, and internal reviews through Zipline&rsquo;s aviation compliance portal.
	Maintain compliance dashboards, trackers, and structured datasets covering licenses, permits, certificates, approvals, renewals, regulatory commitments, operational limitations, special conditions, open actions, and upcoming deadlines across multiple countries.
	Support compliance monitoring activities, including audit readiness, findings management, non-compliance tracking, CAPA follow-up, and closure-evidence capture.
	Prepare and maintain documentation related to safety occurrences and regulatory reporting, including data capture, internal follow-up, and record management.
	Independently manage assigned compliance workstreams with minimal supervision, escalating risks, gaps, delays, or unclear requirements as appropriate.
	Standardize compliance processes, documentation structures, reporting templates, training materials, and internal reporting systems as Zipline&rsquo;s operations scale across multiple countries.
	Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of compliance tools, safety management system platforms, and aviation compliance portals.
	Partner with country teams, operations leaders, safety teams, and aviation regulatory colleagues to identify compliance needs, translate regulatory requirements into practical systems, and support field-level implementation.


What You&#39;ll Bring&nbsp;


	2-5 years of experience in aviation compliance, quality, safety, documentation control, or aviation/flight operations (UAS or manned aviation).
	Strong ability to independently manage structured compliance workstreams with high attention to detail.
	Experience conducting or supporting internal audits and managing findings and CAPAs.
	Strong written communication and documentation skills.
	Ability to translate regulatory and operational requirements into clear, auditable systems and records.
	The ideal candidate is comfortable working across jurisdictions with varying regulatory maturity and is able to maintain rigor and consistency in complex, evolving environments.
	Willingness to travel as required.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Business Development Officer",
  "description": "Changeroom was established in 2012 with a vision to produce quality human resource solutions. We plan to achieve this by partnering with our clients to provide highly specialized consulting services in the areas of human resources development and business management services. Our partnership approach affords us the opportunity of working with you to find the most efficient and appropriate solutions to meet your short, medium and long-term goals. In partnering with your organization, we make it our business to understand your business, embrace its values, aims and objectives.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsiblities


	Conduct thorough market research to identify industry trends, market dynamics, and potential opportunities for growth.
	Analyze market data, competitor activities, and customer preferences to inform business development strategies.
